description: This Scala source file defines date formatting utilities for Apache Spark, including classes for ISO8601 and default date formatting, legacy formatters based on Apache Commons and SimpleDateFormat, and a companion object for creating formatter instances with various configurations.

classes.name: DateFormatter
classes.description: A sealed trait defining the interface for date formatters, including parse and format methods, and pattern validation.

classes.name: Iso8601DateFormatter
classes.description: A date formatter for ISO8601 patterns, supporting parsing and formatting of LocalDate, Date, and days since epoch.

classes.name: DefaultDateFormatter
classes.description: A date formatter that uses a default pattern and supports parsing strings into days since epoch.

classes.name: LegacyDateFormatter
classes.description: A trait for legacy date formatters based on older libraries like Apache Commons FastDateFormat and SimpleDateFormat.

classes.name: LegacyFastDateFormatter
classes.description: A legacy formatter based on Apache Commons FastDateFormat, using JVM default timezone for compatibility.

classes.name: LegacySimpleDateFormatter
classes.description: A legacy formatter based on java.text.SimpleDateFormat, using JVM default timezone for compatibility.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into days since epoch.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats days since epoch, Date, or LocalDate into a string.

methods.name: validatePatternString
methods.description: Validates the pattern string used for formatting/parsing.

methods.name: getFormatter
methods.description: Creates a DateFormatter based on optional pattern, locale, legacy format, and parsing flag.

methods.name: getLegacyFormatter
methods.description: Creates a legacy formatter based on pattern, locale, and legacy format type.
